notes.title: Fix for jumping issues
notes.notes: Fixes jumping off falling platforms when playing on a screen with a high refresh rate.

notes.title: Verified on Steam Deck - Jet Kave Goes Steam Handheld Mode!
notes.notes:
Jet Kave Adventure is now verified for Steam Deck!
Now you can jetpack through the prehistoric era wherever you are!


Jet Kave Adventure is now fully functional on Steam Deck and fully works with the in-built controls and displays. All functions are accessible, display correct icons, and optimized size text and games default graphics configuration performs well on the platform.

Try Steam Deck Verified Jet Kave Adventure!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue with leaderboard scores not uploading for the level 4-9.
- Fixed an issue preventing players from completing the Collectible Challenge on a few levels.
- Improved the loading flow on startup, especially on slower machines.
- Fixed an issue with two music tracks playing simultaneously during some cutscenes.
- Tweaked the size of subtitles when playing in higher screen resolutions.
- Other minor fixes.
